title: The Kept Whistle
introNarration: Midge grounds her spear in the mud. "Examine the whistle post. North is the rope-island. If the sentry is still posted, defeat the sentry. Then talk midge. A warning that does not sound is just another thing kept."
reminderNarration: "Examine the whistle post. Defeat the rope-sentry on the rope-island. Then talk midge. Type south from the rope-island."
completionNarration: Midge hangs a skipper whistle on a cord and puts it in your paw. "Marram is at the landing. Talk marram. The captain is south of the slip, in the camp. I will fish. You will finish it."

objectives.label: Examine the Whistle Post at Heron Post.
Defeat the Rope Sentry on the Rope Island. Type north from Heron Post.
